text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen about 6% from Period 1, so I should pay attention to overall risk and diversification rather than judging each holding in isolation.","Selling Stock B at a large loss reminded me not to let my average cost dictate a decision; I should assess its prospects and portfolio role using current information.","I rarely trade, and most periods I made no changes; I should keep that deliberate approach, but review the portfolio periodically so inaction remains a choice rather than neglect."]}
